runtime_conflicts_verified.origin: Added JEED 1.21-2.3.4 serializer omits type=mob_effect. EMI 1.1.24 reads type before selecting a serializer.
runtime_conflicts_verified.observedImpact: Language reload logs a caught NullPointerException in EmiSidebars.load; stored Haste lookup is discarded. Page itself still works.
runtime_conflicts_verified.potentialImpact: Favorites and hidden effects use the same serializer; not separately exercised.
runtime_conflicts_verified.dataPolicy: No user histories/favorites cleared or rewritten.
runtime_conflicts_verified.fix: Optional client-only companion mixin adds type=mob_effect to JEED serializer output only when absent; no hard JEED/EMI dependency and no history migration.

runtime_conflicts_verified.origin: Accessories embedded in pinned Aether and existing Curios each emit a Back slot line; backpack has both item tags.
runtime_conflicts_verified.observedImpact: Two slot labels, including Accessories English fallback in Spanish. No additional container panel from this batch.
runtime_conflicts_verified.configFinding: Accessories showEquippedStackSlotType governs experimental equipped UI, not this tooltip callback; no suitable config fix found.
runtime_conflicts_verified.fix: Companion client event removes only the exact redundant Accessories Back component when the pinned Curios Back component is present on a Sophisticated Backpack.
